Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of V.
Our gross margin expanded by 97 basis points to 65.3%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 9% to 17% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2020.
Operating income reached $11.2 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 9% to 17% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $6.76 per share.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Revenue guidance of $41.9 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
